context: A mom and son spot something in the park
purpose: Teach: 正体/気力/叫ぶ/誘わ/親族/見つめる/うれしく/年上

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、あれ何?正体が分からないよ。
lines.en: Mom, what is that? I don't know what it is.
lines.style: Soft, observant curiosity. Leans in slightly. Genuine question — not performative wonder. Simple, direct phrasing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、ただの落ち葉よ。気力使いすぎないでね。
lines.en: Just a fallen leaf, sweetie. Don't tire yourself out too much.
lines.style: Gentle laugh underneath the words. Practical reassurance. Warm but grounded — the voice of someone noticing his energy levels.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: こないだ、年上のお姉ちゃんと遊びに誘われたんだ。
lines.en: A girl from the upper grades asked me to play the other day.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the telling. Hesitant — checking if it matters enough to mention. Small smile audible in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うれしくて報告してくれたのね。
lines.en: You came straight to tell me, didn't you? I could see how happy you were.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Not asking, reflecting back what she's observed. Patient, attentive — the reassurance of being truly seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 親族のおじちゃんも、いつも見つめる目が優しい。
lines.en: Uncle always looks at me with such kind eyes.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Speaking carefully — noticing something he's been thinking about. Small, genuine warmth in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 転んでも、叫ぶ前にお母さん呼んでね。
lines.en: Even when you fall, call for me before you cry out.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not stern. Matter-of-fact care underneath. The quiet confidence of a mother who knows her child will listen.
